issue.title: Thin visual separation between adjacent deleted and inserted word runs in the pager word diff

task_type_fields.proposal: PROPOSED BY phase bead sase-1ef.5 (epic sase-1ef, plan plan:202610/pager_version_clarity.md §10). In the pager word-diff view (src/sase/pager/history/diff.py, INSERT_STYLE/DELETE_STYLE runs), adjacent deleted and inserted word runs render with no gap, so 'type: short → core' reads as 'shortcore'. Add a thin visual separation between them (for example a styled zero-content boundary or a thin-space glyph drawn only in the rendered layer) while keeping the search corpus and copy text character-aligned with the underlying content, so / search, y copy, and line/column marks are unaffected.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1ef listed this as a non-goal follow-up (§10 'Word diff spacing'); it is a diff-rendering refinement independent of version identity, and the search-corpus alignment constraint needs its own design and tests.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by phase bead sase-1ef.5 as the plan's §10 follow-up: in the pager word-diff body, a struck deleted run and the inserted run that replaces it abut (e.g. 'short'+'core'), which reads as one mangled word.
